description.p: High-performance, scalable cross-platform asynchronous I/O event loop library based on native OS multiplexers (epoll, io_uring, kqueue, IOCP).
Main entry point and factory unit for the fcl-eventloop package.

element.name: TEventLoop
element.short: Static factory for event loops, worker groups, sockets, and non-blocking I/O primitives.

descr.p: Use TEventLoop.Create to instantiate an event loop with a preferred or automatic backend. Use TEventLoop.CreateGroup for multi-reactor worker pools capable of handling 100,000+ concurrent connections.

description.p: Core interfaces, callback signatures, buffer definitions, and error classes for asynchronous event processing.

element.name: IEventLoop
element.short: Primary interface representing a single-threaded asynchronous event reactor.

element.name: IEventLoopGroup
element.short: Interface for managing a multi-threaded pool of event loop reactors.

description.p: Non-blocking asynchronous TCP client/server, datagram sockets, and integration with IFuture and TCancellationToken.

element.name: IAsyncServerSocket
element.short: Non-blocking TCP listening server socket with eager accept.
